body: Dispatched two delivery-lead agents in parallel, each in its own git worktree off main at 4458ba76, one per criterion. The two units share no file, so they can run concurrently without branch-switching under each other.U+000AU+000Ac1 lead: branch `fix/close-releases-pointer`. Owns `src/server/tools/close_thread.ts` and `src/domain/pointer.ts`, red test first in a new `test/spawn/close.test.ts`. Briefed to check `test/spawn/lifecycle.test.ts` for existing close coverage before adding, and to decide deliberately between releasing the pointer inside close_thread, treating a pointer that names a terminal thread as absent on read, or both — with the guard that an unconditional release would steal another session's hold when the pointer names a different thread.U+000AU+000Ac2 lead: branch `fix/decision-scope-derives`. Owns `src/server/tools/record_decision.ts`, test in the existing `test/spawn/decisions.test.ts`, updating rather than duplicating any existing scope case. Briefed to assert the derived `criterion N` label positively rather than settling for the criterion's "not empty" floor, and to leave the byte-cap path that reports `linked` and `link_skipped_reason` intact.U+000AU+000ABoth briefs carry the same hard constraints: red on the parent commit plus an inertness mutation, plain `npm test` with no coverage flag, no `npm install` against the vendored node_modules, merge never rebase, PR only through the centralized pr-create tool with honest verification lines, no merge. Neither lead has ledger tools; both return decision text for me to record from here.
